newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler names Robert Lutz as vice chairman.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler names Robert Lutz as vice chairman.

text.p: Chrysler Corp., formalizing plans to keep President Robert Lutz on its payroll past the age of 65 and develop a new generation of managers, said Thursday its board of directors named Lutz vice chairman.

The board gave Lutz' president title to Chairman and Chief Executive officer Robert Eaton, who will take on more day-to-day operating duties. Lutz, who also served as chief operating officer, is expected to stay on for two more years, a company spokesman said.
